steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hyah—!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrrowagh!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Noir Corne! Mew almost cut me in half!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ah, sorry. I still haven't gotten the hang of this Long Sword yet.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: These fellows look even scarier than the ones we saw in the cave befur.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Judging from the Originium crystal distribution on their bodies, the infection seems to be quite severe, and they're moving so quickly, as if trying to flee.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mew must be quite curious about how I gnaw so much. It's because I've been observing the endemic lifeforms affected by originium the whole time—

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Hey, are mew even listening?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Saving people is more important than that! We need to go take a look!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hello? It's safe now, where are you?
Here! Over here!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Huh... over here?
Yes, behind this sliding door.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...There's nothing blocking the door though?
Huh? How is that possible? I've tried everything I could to open it, to no avail.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Uh, how about lifting this handle down here?
Hmm? Like this...? Ah! It opened!
So that's how it works? No wonder I had so much difficulty finding it. Haha, what an ingenious design!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So... were you trapped like that for the last three days?
That's right, heheh... Maybe I was a bit too obsessed with my research. After all, it's such a rare finding...

spans.text: That's right, heheh... Maybe I was a
too obsessed with my research. After all, it's such a rare finding...

steps.text: Oh? What's this soft thing under my feet?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Uh... the corpse of an Originium slug. May I ask who you are?
Sorry there, sluggy...
Ah, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Mirai Takii, an ecological researcher.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Noir Corne, the horns on her head are diffurent than yours!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: You said your name was... Mirai?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: We're operators from Rhodes Island, on a mission in the area. I'm Noir Corne, and this is—

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrrow! So you're a scholar of the environment here?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Of course! I'm in the middle of an ecological survey, actually.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: May I take a look at your research notes, purrty please?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Wha— Ah! What is this adorable talking creature?! What's it going to do?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow! I'm not some creature, I'm a Felyne, and a researcher myself to boot! Look, I have meow own research notes here.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Wow, you even sketched the little explosion that Fukurami herbs make? That's one of my favorites. Did you know that it explodes from the pressure of the liquid inside the fruit?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: That was my hypawthesis! As the fruit ripens, the mucus inside gradually builds up—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey, uh, I'm the one who saved you, so mind answering my questions first?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Oh fine.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...So how did you get stuck down here in the first place?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: It was part of my ecological survey, I did say that I'm a researcher, didn't I?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Okay, next question—

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Hold on! Let me talk first! I've got some incredible news for you all! You'll never guess what I saw!

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Do you know what's living in this cave?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: A—super—big—FLYING MONSTER!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Flying! Monster! Breathes Fire!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...Gotcha.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: 'G-Gotcha'? Do you not find it the least bit interesting?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It's called a Rathalos, and we were on its back before getting thrown down here.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Ah... How could this be...?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: What a tragedy... it turned out to be a creature that's already known. I was even going to name it after a character from a manga I read recently...I got so excited over nothing...

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Wait! Talking creature, I've never seen anything like you before! Are you... a new species?

spans.text: Wait! Talking creature, I've never seen anything like
before! Are you... a new species?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: W-What are mew doing! Get your paws off me!

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Just let me take a good look!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hold on, let's get down to business first. Did you come into contact with the Rathalos?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Yes, I observed it for a good while. I recorded its actions in the mine and what changes it went through within the Originium zone, but now it feels like that was all a waste of time.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mew recorded its behavior?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Originium zone? Changes?!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Give— No... could you please show us those records? This is really important!

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Of course, just wait here for a bit while I find them.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow? Food, drinking water, even light equipment... What's all this?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Protective gear for the Originium, of course.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: ...How well-purrpared. No wonder mew managed to last three days down here.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: I even brought some carbonated Suzuka-flavored drinks.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Noir Corne, there's a ladder here, maybe we can escape through the hole we came from.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: This looks like the entrance to the Originium processing plant, where did you see the Rathalos?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Not too far from here, just straight ahead through this hole in the mine shaft.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: The shaft you came down was the one closest to the mine, and was only abandoned because it was too far from the village. I imagine it's the most convenient for the Rathalos to fly in and out from.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: You seem awfully familiar with the place.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Enough to get by.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Oh right, here.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: And this is?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: The Rathalos brought you two here, right? So I'm guessing you were separated from your other companions.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: You can make use of the vent over there to send a smoke signal, to help them to find you.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Thank you very much.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Anyway, here are all my notes, but my handwriting might be a little messy, so I'll read them out loud for you while you have a look.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Four days ago, the Rathalos flew into the cave at night, and the miners changing shifts were scared away.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: The flames it spewed also triggered a small explosion which led to a partial collapse of the mine, and thus sealed the passage to the village.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: No wonder there was so much active Originium dust...

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Mm, it doesn't seem to be doing so well itself. The huge amount of Originium dust has noticeably affected it. In particular it has difficulty feeding and an increasingly violent temperament.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: I used an instrument to examine the dust in more detail, and could see a large amount of particles suspended around it. Every time it breathes fire, the dust is set aflame, causing great devastation... We're lucky it hasn't wrecked the mine yet.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Noir Corne! That's why its flames are so pawerful!

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Ah, did you come across it while outside?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: More than once, even... It's why we came in the first place, actually. It's been spreading Originium dust all over the village.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: In that case, I must stress that if you want to deal with it, now might be the best time.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Because it's in an extremely weakened state, and though it can recover quickly, it will still take some time. Also, the mine has been overused to the point of becoming structurally unstable.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: So if you just detonated bombs in certain spots, you could instantly collapse the entire mine.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'm a little worried about the Rathalos spewing fire while we're doing that, though. It'd ignite all the Originium dust and... Well, the consequences would be disastrous.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Yes, but you have to trust me. As long as you follow my plan, it won't have a chance to open its jaws, let alone spit out an ember.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: The only problem is that we don't have enough people to set up bombs in all the locations I marked on the map. We'd need at least one more, or it'll be virtually impossible to get it done by today.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: It would be purrfect if Yato were here then.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Is that another of your companions?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Yes, a very serious, but reliable lass. She also has two other Felynes like me by her side.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Then we should have enough, but...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: But what?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: It's about the Rathalos. I still have some questions that might influence your final decision.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Check my notes on page 237, in the bottom right corner.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: I've done some research into the materials it leaves behind, and found out that it's not actually infected with Oripathy. Which means its changes were not due to the infection.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: They're not? Then why does it have so meowch trouble feeding...

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: I doubt it's completely unaffected by Originium, but I still wouldn't say it has Oripathy... What's even stranger is that more and more Originium clusters are forming on its body.

spans.text: unaffected by Originium, but I still wouldn't say it has Oripathy... What's even stranger is that more and more Originium clusters are forming on its body.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Uh, so... if the Rathalos isn't infected, the Originium clusters on its body might just be a temporary thing? And maybe it's not the one spreading the Originium dust?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: That's my theory, but I don't have any hard evidence to confirm it. Besides...

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: The Rathalos's behavior towards Originium is also remarkably different from other creatures I've observed, and... it's really difficult to describe.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: I think it's best if you just see it for yourselves.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Let's go, Noir Corne! Odd-horned Scholar, can mew show us the way?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: No, wait...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Oh, right, mew just escaped.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: I don't mind.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: No, that's not what I—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The communicator—We got a signal.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Oh, maybe it's due to the signal booster here.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Can mew try and contact Yato? Hurry and tell her what's going on here!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: First, I have to ask you something important, Ms. Takii.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Huh? Me?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: You came into the mine alone but with ample resources, before the Rathalos even arrived.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: You're very familiar with the place, but weren't with the miners when they changed shifts, otherwise you wouldn't have gotten stuck here.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: From my experience with the villagers and how sus they've been about the mine, I doubt they'd let an outsider conduct an ecological survey here.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: In short, I have some doubts about your identity.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Not to mention your family name... it's the same as the headman of Roka Village, right?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So you're related to him, but you don't mind teaching us how to destroy the mine, and are happy to guide us to the Rathalos.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Mirai Takii, what exactly is your angle here?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Oh dear. I wasn't trying to hide anything, but I suppose it was just a matter of time.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Were mew playing a trick on us? I see, so you weren't a scholar after all! Then... who exactly are you?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: No, I really am an ecological researcher, got all my papers and everything.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: I did omit a few details, like the fact that Ataru is my uncle, or that I actually snuck into the mine.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: I also knew that you were from Rhodes Island, because I'm the one who left your contact information for my uncle to find. I'm assuming he couldn't handle the Originium dust the Rathalos was spreading, so he called you guys in.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: You left him our contact info? Why?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Because I wanted to shut down the mine, and there was no way I could convince the entire village by myself.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Originally, I was planning to contact you myself.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: I figured that once you saw what was going on here, you'd do whatever it took to get the villagers away from here, right? Unfortunately, they confiscated my external communication equipment before I could.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: So I thought I'd come down here on my own, and figure out how to destroy it myself.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What made you so sure we'd evacuate the village? It wasn't even guaranteed that we'd stop them from mining... Also, I still don't know why you want to destroy the mine.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Because if Roka Village continues to dig any deeper, this place will probably suffer a... a Catastrophe.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: A Catastrophe?! How soon are we talking?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Hard to say right now, since at this point it's just an anomaly in the surrounding environment.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So the 'Mirai' we saw earlier was you leaving your mark after your investigation...

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Yup. Then I assume you've been in a situation where it felt like you were just going in circles for hours. That's an effect of the anomaly.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: The bad news is that said anomaly is getting even worse.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: And I'm pretty sure our big boy Rathalos is heading the same way, though I haven't seen it do its flamethrower thing in its lair yet.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Of course, everything would be solved if you just went along with my plan.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: But why would the mine here cause a Catastrophe?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Because... Well, you'll understand once you see it.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Yato! Mew are bleeding!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Probably from when the Rathalos's tailspin that sent me hurtling to the ground. Some debris got into the wound, so I didn't notice it until now.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It entered from the inner thigh... Can't tell how deep it is until I pull the debris out.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Do you have any medicine to help treat this?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow...

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Not this, or this..

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's alright, Artisan. Is there anything that can be used as a rope?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Yes! Just wrap some grass together, like a braid!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: How strong is it... that should hold.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And do you have anything that can burn?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Found something! It burns.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Alright, then please make a fire... And this is for you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: After the fire gets going, wipe this dagger clean, and put it over the flames, can you do that?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Yes, but mew...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: *Huff*...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Captain's log number four, this is Rhodes Island Operations Team A4... Captain Yato.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: In the previous battle with the Rathalos, I was separated from Operator Noir Corne, but our primary objective to track the creature has not changed. However... due to my current injury, the operation has been temporarily suspended.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: During this mission, we encountered many difficulties that far exceeded our expectations, and progress has not at all been smooth sailing.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...But I still believe in our ability to complete the mission, whatever the cost.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I am now preparing to begin emergency field surgery on my wound, and will make an audio recording of the process for review purposes after the mission...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Breathes deeply)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: First, I will remove the shard of debris from the wound.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Ngh—Argh!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Blood! So meowch blood!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: *Pant* *pant*...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Next... using a rope to stop the bleeding...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Argh—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: *pant**pant*...The wound... I can see the bone, but at least none of my arteries were hit...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Needs disinfection... scraping away the dirt...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Ah—*hiss*

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Disinfection... complete. Next... to ensure the rest of the operation proceeds smoothly, I must make sure I remain mobile.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: In the absence of medicine and bandages... I have decided to use...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Artisan, is it ready?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: It's ready.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Now cauterizing... the wound. End audio log.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Hand me the knife.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Breathes deeply)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Presses the knife to the edge of the wound)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Ahh—*hiss*——Augh!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Hgh!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Yato! Are mew alright?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...I'm... I'm fine.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The wound... Alright, the bleeding's stopped.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Over there! Look!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: A smoke signal... from Noir Corne? It's in the direction that the Palico pointed out, so they must have come across the Rathalos. I'm glad they're doing well at least.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The sky... It should be almost dawn by now, but it's still so dim? Black clouds...? Hm?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What's that noise?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Forest! Rumbling and shaking!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: That sound! It's a beast!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Over there!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The beasts are dashing out from the forest!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: There are so many of them... Have they noticed something?
Help! Help us!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Someone's calling for help! Let's go!

steps.name: Impatient Villager
steps.text: Kuso! Why are there so many of them?!

steps.name: Timid Villager
steps.text: I told you not to listen to the headman's orders to enter the forest! It's just a few outsiders... Help!

steps.name: Impatient Villager
steps.text: Stop yelling! Why would there be anyone else in this damn forest? We better think of something before we die here!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Villagers? What are they doing here?

steps.name: Timid Villager
steps.text: See! The yelling worked!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Come with me, quickly. I'll lead you out of here.

steps.name: Impatient Villager
steps.text: Can we head over there? I think we can avoid the beasts' rampage that way.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We can try.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We're here. Seems like the beasts aren't headed in this direction for now.

steps.name: Timid Villager
steps.text: Huh? You're...

steps.name: Timid Villager
steps.text: It's them! The outsiders the headman wanted us to find! So they were still alive!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The headman sent you after us?

steps.name: Impatient Villager
steps.text: That combat ability... No wonder Mirai left Rhodes Island's contact information. She did say you weren't your average pharmacists.

steps.name: Impatient Villager
steps.text: The headman said the cave-in might not have trapped you, so he told us to go look for you in the mountains.

steps.name: Impatient Villager
steps.text: And if we found you, to take you far, far away from the village.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Why would he do that?

steps.name: Timid Villager
steps.text: Ah, save it for later! The beasts are headed this way!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Their numbers have increased as well. If this keeps up...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Curses, this is my fault for letting Kashiwau go alone. Even though the Palico followed him, given the current situation...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Can you two get to a safe place by yourselves?

steps.name: Impatient Villager
steps.text: From here? Should be able to.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Sorry, I can't continue to escort you. Stay safe, and if you manage to return to the village, please tell the residents to evacuate as soon as possible!

steps.name: Impatient Villager
steps.text: Got it, and... thank you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Artisan, we should go help Kashiwau.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Um, what about Noir Corne?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Right, they should still be with the Rathalos. I should update him on the plan, but... there's no time for that now.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: *doot**doot*—*doot**doot*—

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Comms! Alive!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's Corne. I'm glad we caught the signal.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato, can you hear me?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm here. I'm seeing a smoke signal from my location, is that yours?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yeah, I'm with the Felyne Scholar and we're safe for the time being, how are things on your end?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm... doing fine.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne, do you know what the situation is like outside?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The beginnings of a Catastrophe, yeah?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Yes, there have been some obvious tells. Judging from the situation, there's still time to evacuate the villagers, but the wild beasts in the forest have already started rampaging.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We need to update each other on the situation to coordinate our actions.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Not long ago... I made the mistake of clashing with Kashiwau and letting him go off on his own.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: He might be in some kind of danger right now, and I think... I should prioritize saving him over rendezvousing with you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm still not clear how we'll deal with the Rathalos, but it is highly likely that he'll lose his life on his own.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It was my fault, so I absolutely cannot leave him behind.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I get you, but I gotta tell you something too.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...What is it?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Right now, we're above the Rathalos's nest, and we found out it's connected to the cave in the village...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It's an Originium mine. That's the source of the dust that the Rathalos has been spreading.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So that's what it was...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Also... we have a really good plan to deal with the Rathalos.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: If we destroy the mine and bury it in the rubble, we'll be able to take care of it once and for all. It won't be able to spread any more Oripathy, and the villagers can evacuate without any worries too.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Can you confirm the feasibility of this plan?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It was hatched by someone who's researched the mine in depth. But if we want to do this right away, just me and the Felyne Scholar won't be enough. We'll need your help too.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: If we miss this opportunity, who knows what kind of accident might happen? In the worst case scenario, we'll probably be facing an unprecedented crisis, so we need you to make the call.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What a dilemma we've gotten ourselves into...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato, listen to me.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Remember what we decided back then? We've already made our choice.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Nonsense... I never said I couldn't do it.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm not changing my decision. I'll go look for Kashiwau right away, while you do your best to keep the situation over there under control.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I will save his life, and I won't let the Rathalos harm anyone else either.

spans.text: save his life, and I won't let the Rathalos harm anyone else either.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'll save everyone.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Alright, be careful out there.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You too.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Die! All of you, die!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Get out of my sight!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You scamp... just why did you...?

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Don't hold me back, old timer.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You truly don't have a brain up there, do you?!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: A group of hunters... who know not the rules of the forest, much less respect them. And in provoking its wrath, sent all the beasts into a frenzy, trampling all over our crops.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Well, fantastic! I suppose they'll get their just deserts!

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: All they brought were some mining tools. There's no way they can handle that many wild beasts.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: So I... I have to go in there, I can't just stand back and watch them get torn apart.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Aren't you also against the Originium mining project? This is perfect for us, is it not?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Those fools in the forest were asking for it! Just let nature consume them, as it should!

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Old timer, as a hunter of the village, I of all people can't sit back at a time like this.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You idiotic, wretched, brat!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You step outside this room, and I'll break both your legs!

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: But you never did stop me from going.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Which is how I ended up like that.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Yes, yes, it was all me.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I caused your death... It's all my fault, I'm a terrible father.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: You should feel ashamed of your incompetence.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: And you must also pay for your sins.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Yes, I should, which is why I've been trying to kill all the beasts here in your stead.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Especially that most wicked, enormous, insane fire-spewing monster!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: ...But I am incapable of hunting it.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: These hands of mine are too old to properly wield a spear, and mine eyes so clouded I can only watch milkbeasts frolic around.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Then lay down and die.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Die. Yes, that's about the only thing I am capable of now.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Kill one, and then another.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: And then... I will be able to see you again.
He wanted to swing his hunting spear.
But his arms had no more strength, letting it fall to the ground.
He had no desire to retrieve it, for it had lost all purpose.
The beast bared its fangs, and was about to tear its prey apart.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Hah, denied the chance... A beast clad in scales... Now that's a sight I've not seen in...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: And now, the beasts mutually rend each other apart.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Will I die beneath the claws and teeth of these monsters...?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Yato, your meowjesty, I advise mew to reconsider, for it will not be easy to get out of this.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: What is that...? Someone's voice?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Just tell me how you can help me, or I'll just cut my way through.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Someone's speaking... am I just imagining things?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's not time for you to die yet, old man.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: What are you still doing here, girl?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Saving you.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You should have left this place, not come to my aid!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Fuzakeru na!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Didn't you say you were going to hunt the Rathalos? Yet you're so willing to die to some nameless beast?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Open your eyes already! The frenzied beasts are going to rush down the mountain sooner or later, and the first thing they'll trample over will be the village... Your neighbors will be forced to scatter and flee, and innocent children will die.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Are you going to just stand by and watch all of that happen?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Yoshitaka Kashiwau, you are a hunter of Roka Village. And as its only hunter, you of all people can't sit back at a time like this.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The last thing you should be doing is feeling sorry for yourself here, much less giving up your life so easily.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Wield that spear in your hands, abandon those useless obsessions, and think carefully on what a hunter's duty is!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: To defend their home from the sharp claws of beasts, to desperately keep the flame of survival lit!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: True, somebody will always be forced to bear the price... Hunters, as well as us... But we have both chosen this path.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Now get up!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Akira...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: What was it that you said back then, to get me to let you go...

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: I said... that I would defeat them all.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Did you succeed?

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: I did, father.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Akira...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You've got a damn good spear, boy. I should hold onto it tight.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Go, and never appear before me again.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I will defeat them all.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: That's enough... noise from you.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You don't speak much, girl. But when you do, you're fiercer than a mangler.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If you have the strength to talk, then stop wasting time and cover the rear.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I have no reason to take orders from a whippersnapper... Mind your own business.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Your meowjesty's words remind me so much of my time in Kokoto Village.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Before the age of the Hunters, it was the headman who first stepped up to defend the village from meownsters, earning the title of 'hero' for his bravery...

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Mrow! Please do not pick me up by the scruff of the neck.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Palico, watch our right.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Do you remember the moves I spoke of earlier, your meowjesty?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Well, I've gone over them in my head a few times.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Mew must remember, the trick to using the Dual Blades to their fullest potential is to abandon all defense and enter a state alike to a ferocious beast.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Or as we call it, 'Demon Mode.'

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: 'Demon Mode,' huh...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We move.
